Production share by country, per mineral

Top three named countries highlighted. The Other bucket is drawn hatched because it aggregates many unnamed producers and is not a country.

CR3 against HHI

Two measures, two scales, two charts. Cobalt is the most concentrated mineral at both the top-3 level and across the whole distribution.

Indian state manganese resource distribution

Eleven states. The national total row is excluded from the ranking and used only as a reconciliation check.

Import exposure

Import value against the domestic resource base that is not being mined. Manganese is drawn as a gap rather than omitted, because a missing bar reads as a zero.

Projected Indian demand 2025 to 2030

Nickel and cobalt only. The workbook carries no manganese demand projection, so none is shown.

Strategic Vulnerability Score inputs

The framework is designed and its inputs are published. The score itself is deliberately left uncomputed.

Strategic Vulnerability Score inputs. Score = 0.40 x import dependence + 0.35 x (mining HHI / 100) + 0.25 x refining leader share. All inputs sit on a 0 to 100 scale before weighting.

Cobalt100.00proxy58.57lower bound80.00partialnot computedINPUTS PRESENT BUT NOT COMPLETE: import_dependence, mining_hhi, refining_leader_share
Manganeseno data20.21lower boundno datanot computedINPUTS ABSENT: import_dependence, refining_leader_share
Score not computed. The gate is that all three inputs must exist and be complete for a mineral. No mineral clears it. Nickel and cobalt carry a proxy import dependence and a partial refining share, and manganese is missing both an import table and a refining figure. A weighted number built on those inputs would read as a measurement when it is an assumption.
Sources, as cited inside the workbook: IBM National Mineral Inventory and Indian Minerals Yearbook (manganese resources and production); Ministry of Mines reply in Rajya Sabha, PIB Delhi 05-Aug-2024 (nickel and cobalt resources, demand projection); UN COMTRADE via Trading Economics (nickel imports, CY2024); IndexBox (cobalt imports, CY2023); USGS Mineral Commodity Summaries 2025 (mine production); USGS Global Maps of Critical Mineral Production 2023 (refining shares, partial coverage). Import values are US dollars. Resource position is as on 01.04.2020.
